observations.code_quote: The classic picker and the rebuilt menu hold aggregated search results until the contributing categories settle. This prevents late category results from moving a choice under the pointer. Only categories offered by the picker contribute to that wait; a category-specific list waits for its own results. Recent and Pinned scopes use pre-resolved entries and never enter this search loading barrier.
